title: Intelligent Symbiosis: AI + 5G-A Redefining Sustainable Guardianship in Human-Wildlife Shared Zones
summary: China Mobile reports monitoring expanding from 120 to 330 square kilometers, 60% wider wildlife distribution, and 97% fewer collision-related animal deaths.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Xiamen reserve solution combines vessel monitoring, wildlife analysis, and AI-supported management. Following commercial deployment in 2024, the submission reports broader monitoring, less offshore enforcement, and improved wildlife measures. Underlying counts and a controlled comparison are unavailable for these aggregate claims.
purpose: Improve marine-reserve monitoring and reduce human-wildlife conflict.
system: Intelligent Symbiosis: AI + 5G-A Redefining Sustainable Guardianship in Human-Wildlife Shared Zones
deployer: Xiamen Chinese White Dolphin Amphioxus Nature Reserve Affairs Center
location: Xiamen, China; additional pilots in Nanjing and Dalian

ratings.reason: Monitoring reportedly expanded from 120 to 330 square kilometers, with 45% better detection and enforcement efficiency.
Coastal enforcement deployments reportedly fell by 50%, reducing the need for offshore trips. Individual safety outcomes remain unquantified.
The project claims 60% wider wildlife distribution and 97% fewer collision-related animal deaths. Underlying counts and causal controls are unspecified.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 13: Intelligent Symbiosis: AI + 5G-A Redefining Sustainable Guardianship in Human-Wildlife Shared Zones

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: AI and 5G expand marine-reserve monitoring in Xiamen
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
